scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate:dev: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -e ../../apps/api/.env -- prisma migrate dev --config dist/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -e ../../apps/api/.env -- prisma migrate deploy --config dist/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:migrate:status: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -e ../../apps/api/.env -- prisma migrate status --config dist/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:migrate:reset: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -e ../../apps/api/.env -- prisma migrate reset --config dist/prisma.config.js
